summary.text: Nancy McDowell is the Democratic candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 29, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Nancy Theriault.
McDowell is a former federal law enforcement officer with U.S. Customs and Border Protection who has lived in northern Maine for more than 40 years.

paragraphs.text: Nancy McDowell graduated from Houlton High School and earned a bachelor's degree in liberal studies with a concentration in business administration from the University of Maine at Presque Isle.

In a Ballotpedia survey, McDowell said she has lived and worked in northern Maine for more than 40 years and worked as a Customs and Border Protection officer, and that her earlier jobs included day care provider, real estate broker and property manager.
She said she supports tax reform and expanded child care resources, rural health care and telehealth, home care options for seniors and veterans, and investment in schools and manufacturing jobs.
